title: Graphics lab access
body: Request a workstation and download the rendering toolkit before your first visit.

title: Campus newsletter
body: The graphics lab team held a graphics lab showcase. Alumni visited the graphics lab for demos.

title: Lost property
body: Collect misplaced belongings from the east gate after showing a description.

title: Library renewals
body: Extend an existing book loan online before the return date.

title: Volunteer digest
body: Library renewals and lost property are newsletter topics. Volunteers answered library renewals queries.

title: Observatory hours
body: The astronomy club opens the rooftop telescope after dusk on Fridays.

title: Campus network
body: Register your laptop to connect to the wireless network in a residence hall.

title: Visitor parking
body: Use the south gate for a day pass. Overnight parking requires a permit.

title: Night shuttle
body: The bus runs between the library and residence halls after evening classes.

title: Parking newsletter
body: The parking committee discussed visitor parking and parking fees with the council.

title: Wireless headphones
body: The media desk lends wireless headphones for recording oral history interviews.

title: Rooftop repairs
body: The rooftop telescope is in the observatory. The rooftop telescope mount was serviced.
